instruction:
Create a LEGO model of the input. Format your response as a list of bricks: <brick dimensions> <brick position>, where the brick position is (x,y,z).
Allowed brick dimensions are 2x4, 4x2, 2x6, 6x2, 1x2, 2x1, 1x4, 4x1, 1x6, 6x1, 1x8, 8x1, 1x1, 2x2, 1x3, 3x1, 2x3, 3x2, 2x8, 8x2.
All bricks are 1 unit tall.
The world is a 48x48x48 grid. All brick cells must have coordinates from 0 to 47.

### Input:
A detailed sedan stretching twelve studs: soft-rounded hood, center grille, paired headlights, leaning windshield, side-window roof, sweeping rear to a stubby lit trunk, mirrors out wide and notched-arch wheels below.
prompt: A detailed sedan stretching twelve studs: soft-rounded hood, center grille, paired headlights, leaning windshield, side-window roof, sweeping rear to a stubby lit trunk, mirrors out wide and notched-arch wheels below.
